           CERIUM OXALICUM

         Oxalate of Cerium


Spasmodic reflex vomiting and spasmodic cough are within the sphere of
        this remedy.   Vomiting of pregnancy  , and of half-digested
        food. Whooping cough, with vomiting and hæmorrhage. Dysmenorrhœa in fleshy, robust women.
        Better when flow is established.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Ingluvin  --(made
        from gizzard of a fowl). Vomiting of pregnancy; gastric neurasthenia. Infantile vomiting and
        diarrhœa. 3x Trit.   Amygdal; Lactic ac; Ipecac  .



Dose.--  First trituration.
